messages:
customer_jd: Hey team — after upgrading to redwood-python-sdk 1.16.0 our background workers started spamming retries and we got a bunch of 401s + duplicate charges. Anyone seen this?

maya_support: thanks for the ping — sorry for the trouble. Can you paste the small repro and the error log? also which auth flow you use (API key vs oauth)?

customer_jd: using API key from env REDWOOD_API_KEY, simple sync client. repro: process fetches model completions in a loop, then on one request we got 401, client retried 3 times automatically, each retry charged. snippet: 
```py
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
resp = client.generate("hello world")
```
log: 
```
ERROR redwood.client 401 Unauthorized: invalid token
INFO redwood.retry Retrying request (attempt 2)
INFO redwood.retry Retrying request (attempt 3)
```

maya_support: that log lines up with a change in 1.16 where default retry behavior was tightened (auto-retries for some 4xx transient auth errors). we should prevent charging on auth failures. can you share pip freeze / lockfile?

customer_jd: pip freeze: 
```
redwood-sdk==1.16.0
requests==2.31.0
```

maya_support: ok. quick workaround: pin to 1.15.2 until we patch. 
```
pip install "redwood-sdk==1.15.2"
```
Also you can disable automatic retries in your client temporarily: 
```py
client = Client(retry_policy={"enabled": False})
```

tom_infra: fyi I'm looking — there's an auth-cache invalidation bug where credentials refresh can mark a request as retryable even when server returns 401. that combo + default retries => duplicate billing. we'll propose an immediate patch to treat 401 as non-retryable unless header explicitly says Retry-After.

eli_research: is there any recommended idempotency guard for these generation calls? customers should be able to avoid duplicate outputs/charges when retry happens.

maya_support: good point — we recommend sending an Idempotency-Key header for non-streaming generation and storing server-side mapping. example: 
```py
client.generate(..., headers={"Idempotency-Key": my_uuid})
```

customer_jd: will that stop billing on server side if client retries?

maya_support: server will dedupe on same key for a reasonable TTL. if you can't add the key, then pin SDK or disable retries.

tom_infra: created INF-4321 and linked to eng-runtime. hotfix branch will treat 401 as terminal and avoid retrying; also we'll add a CLI warning in upgrade notes. link: https://redwood.internal/infra/INF-4321 (private)

maya_support: one more config option we can suggest now: set small max_attempts and backoff to reduce duplicate requests: 
```py
client = Client(retry_policy={"max_attempts": 1, "backoff_factor": 0.2})
```

customer_jd: thanks — applying pin for now. can you confirm a recommended pinned version for everyone?

maya_support: recommend pin to 1.15.2 until hotfix shipped. we'll post release notes and a migration guide highlighting auth and retry changes for 1.16+.

eli_research: long-term we should add a non-retryable status list configurable by customer and expose idempotency examples in the SDK quickstart. filing RD-1012 for docs.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: redwood-sdk 1.16.1-fix-auth-retry -> staging (pr: #9876) :rocket:

maya_support: once staging verifies, we'll coordinate a patch release and notify affected customers. tagging @customer_jd in the follow-up thread. :thumbsup:

customer_jd: appreciate it — pin + idempotency-key workaround fixed our burst. will wait for the patch before upgrading. thanks!
